section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the research hypotheses for a single study. The study aims to validate the BAS in a sample of Black college women and examine the role of ethnic identity in body appreciation. Key hypotheses include supporting a unidimensional factor structure for BAS, positive correlations with appearance satisfaction and self-esteem, negative correlations with Western beauty ideal internalization and eating disordered behaviors, and the mediation of ethnic identity and body appreciation by Western beauty ideal internalization.
